answer: Locks are logged in thread, expire in forge, and vault lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 75 aliases therefore needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2312 identities would post 3459 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
